name: claim-ledger
description: Checks end-of-turn claims like 'tests pass', 'builds cleanly' and 'I've pushed' against the tool calls that actually ran, and notes each claim that has no evidence.

tellModel.title: Tell Claude too
tellModel.description: Also add each flag as a hidden note Claude reads on its next request. It never starts a turn.

testCommands.title: Test commands
testCommands.description: Commands whose successful foreground run backs a 'tests pass' claim, matched as whole words in Bash and PowerShell commands.

buildCommands.title: Build commands
buildCommands.description: Commands whose successful foreground run backs a 'builds cleanly' or 'type-checks' claim.
